reason: The defect is real but this text is incompatible with law already in force. It makes the integration one fast-forward from base to the carrier commit, so main's tip is the carrier, while Act 25 item 7 (as codified, and Act 26 which relies on it) says 'the landing is a fast-forward to exactly that candidate with no commit created at it' and that the landed commit must equal the recorded candidate. The bill amends only Act 21 §§1-5 and never Act 25 item 7, so enacting it leaves two contradictory operative definitions of the landing and a checker could still classify the unit unreadable, now for a new reason. Separately, the Clerk's own check shows the 99% figure is the compliance checker not recognising Act 26 records, not the self-reference, so the urgency rests on a measurement artifact. Clean fix: exempt the post-landing records commit as a carrier under Act 21 §5 without changing the landing target, or amend Act 25 item 7 in the same Act.
